messages.subject: M2 CFI/TLI calculating X2.null and df.null
parts:
Hi Phil,

once again thank you for your latest answers and your whole effort with mirt and mirtCAT!

At the moment I try to figure out an at least interesting behaviour reagarding different models and the change of CFI/TLI RMSEA values.

I tried to "catch" the calculation of the null.model and the corresponding values from X2.null and df.null but am missing something...

Is it possible to get these values from a model or could you tell me how to calculate them?

Any help would be much appreciated,

best
Janine

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: M2 CFI/TLI calculating X2.null and df.null
parts:
Hi Janine,

Do you mean the X2 values from a mirt() function call directly? It likely is possible to do this, though I would warn against it. The tables of counts used to build these statistics become *extremely* sparse very quickly, and so are not reliable. mirt's functions suppress these in the output unless some basic sparseness test is passed first. Otherwise, if you pass calcNull = TRUE you'll force mirt to compute them in the returned object, including stats like RMSEA, CFI, etc, .....though likely a warning message will also be printed to the console. Consider this a public service message before you start checking out the behaviour of these stats. HTH.

Phil
